Cup · Brew, cup and taste

Brewing and cupping

Each brew and each cupping, linked to the roast it came from, with timers, a dial-in guide, blind tasting tests and water you can mix yourself.

Brew

What it is

A brew that names its roast joins the coffee's chain: plot, harvest, run, green lot, roast, cup. Over time you can see which roasts and which recipes gave the cups you liked.

Also inOne coffee, one chainQuality as you go

Step 1 · Log a brew

Open Cup. The Brew tab lists your brews; tap + Brew. Brew several runs timers for several brews at once.

Try it in the app ›

Also inFinding your way

Step 2 · Write down the recipe

Pick the Roast from your Roastbook, or type the Coffee (if not from a roast here). Choose the Method * (V60, AeroPress, espresso, South Indian filter and many more). Then fill what you used: Coffee g, Water g (espresso: yield g), Water °C, Grinder and Grind setting, bloom, total time and pours.

Also inOne coffee, one chainQuality as you go

Step 3 · Time the brew

The large clock on the form starts with a tap. Set a Cut-off time and it alarms when the brew should stop.

Try it in the app ›

Also inQuality as you go

Tip

A Bluetooth scale can fill the coffee and water weights. Open the page in Chrome on Android, or in the Bluefy browser on iPhone; the form says so.

Also inKilos carry forward

Step 4 · Note how it tasted

Under Measure, add TDS % and Beverage g if you have a refractometer. Under Taste, give a Rating out of 10 and tap Pick flavour notes for words to describe it.

Try it in the app ›

Also inQuality as you go

Step 5 · Get closer to the cup I want

Under Dial in, pick where you want to go: Sweeter, Brighter, Fuller body, Less bitter or Cleaner. Or tell it What stands out in the cup?, such as sour, bitter or thin. It suggests what to change, from published findings and common practice, and Put the plan in Next time keeps the plan with the brew. If the section is not there, tick Show brew tips and dial-in help above it.

Also inQuality as you goGuidance, not guarantee

Watch out

The dial-in suggestions are guides, not guarantees, and the form says so. Your taste decides: brew again, rate it, and compare.

Also inGuidance, not guarantee

Tip

Save, and Repeat last copies the recipe into a new brew next time. If you only brew or taste, Now's bottom bar gives you New brew, Repeat last and Brew timer.

Also inNothing gets lostQuality as you go

Brew guide and water

Step 6 · Learn how a brewer works

Brew guide explains each kind of brewer (drip and filter, espresso, moka pot, traditional, cold) at Basic, Intermediate or Advanced level. Its step-by-step guides run a timer and buzz at each step. Protocols are repeatable ways of working: a standard cup, measuring strength, dial-in, freshness, cold brew.

Try it in the app ›

Also inGuidance, not guaranteeQuality as you go

Step 7 · Mix water to the right temperature

Open Water. Type the Hot water °C, Cold water °C, the Final temp wanted °C and how much you need: it tells you how much of each to pour, by weight or by volume. Below, published brewing-water recipes (such as SCA 68/40) make water from two concentrates.

Try it in the app ›

Also inQuality as you go

Cupping and tasting tests

Step 8 · Run a cupping

Open Cup, the Cupping tab, and tap + Cupping. Choose the Protocol: SCA, Barista Hustle 10, Robusta (CQI Fine Robusta) or Simple. Add each sample with + Add sample, one per roast on the table.

Try it in the app ›

Also inQuality as you go

Step 9 · Score the samples

Pour every bowl, then tap Start: the session clock runs. Guided takes you step by step with words for each score; Full form shows everything at once. Switch any time; scores carry over. Save, and the scores show on the roast and its green lot.

Try it in the app ›

Also inQuality as you go

Step 10 · Taste roasts blind

The Tests tab holds blind tasting tests. Triangle asks whether anyone can tell them apart. Describe asks what the difference is. Preference asks which people like. There is also palate training that ranks sour, sweet and salt. Tap + Test.

Try it in the app ›
